_comment: PlantVision — 10 houseplant disease classes. Stage 1 detector is single-class (leaf); the disease decision is owned by Stage 2 (EfficientNet-B0). Pests (spider_mites/aphids/mealybug/scale_insect/whitefly) are NOT classifier outputs — they appear as 'possible_pest_causes' hints per disease (see server/diseases_data.py PEST_INFO). Order matches sorted(ImageFolder.classes), i.e. alphabetical. This file is regenerated automatically by the final cell of train_notebook.ipynb after each training run; the values below are defaults that match the notebook.

training._note: Real values overwritten by the final cell of train_notebook.ipynb after each run.
